# Tests whose result changes from run to run. The check skips them; every run
# also runs them as a report that never fails the check.
#
# ASSERT_ERROR_OK (test/ParametrizedTest.cuh) compares the GPU result with
# OpenFHE's and allows 2^(4 - p), where p is the precision OpenFHE estimates for
# its own result in that run. OpenFHE seeds its random generator on every run
# and no test fixes a seed, so p, and with it the limit, moves from run to run.
# One gtest filter pattern per line.

# These four families flip with no source change on the base commit and with
# this fork's changes applied, over repeated runs on an RTX 5090. On the CI GPU,
# Conjugate/2 passed only on retry and HoistedRotateAllLevels/1 failed twice.
OpenFHEInterfaceTests/OpenFHEInterfaceTest.AccumAllLevels/*
OpenFHEInterfaceTests/OpenFHEInterfaceTest.Conjugate/*
OpenFHEInterfaceTests/OpenFHEInterfaceTest.HoistedRotateAllLevels/*
OpenFHEInterfaceTests/OpenFHEInterfaceTest.RotateAllLevels/*
# Failed in one of three full runs on an RTX 5090.
OpenFHEInterfaceTests/OpenFHEInterfaceTest.HoistedRotate/1
# Brought in with Niobium's branches. A stress test for blocks freed on a
# different stream than they were used on: on the CI GPU it failed all three
# attempts in two of three runs, with and without the upstream merge, and
# passed in the other.
PoolStressTest.AllocateOnOneStreamFreeOnAnother
